references.text: Describes the wave offering (תְּנוּפָה) that the priest shall perform before the Lord, the same ritual as in Leviticus 23:20.
Refers to the bread of the firstfruits (לֶחֶם הַבִּכּוּרִים) that are to be brought forward, which are the same loaves mentioned in verse 20.
Describes the wave offering (תְּנוּפָה) before the Lord, the same type of offering that the priest performs.
The firstfruits (בִּכּוּרִים) belong to the priest, confirming that the offering is holy to the Lord and belongs to the priest.
The remainder of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons as most holy, parallel to how the offering in 23:20 is holy for the priest.
A portion of the offering shall belong to the priest who brings it forward, corresponding to how the offering in 23:20 is for the priest.
The firstfruits of the land's harvest are to be brought to the house of the Lord, forming the basis of the Feast of Firstfruits.
